description: Advisory completeness checks for the tracking and impression callback templates returned by the vendor-published VAST 4 example. Opaque path slots and the generated s field are checked only for emptiness or omission. Token validity, event acceptance, signatures, session state and private variants remain outside this profile.

params.name: tag_token
params.description: The published VAST example emits a nonempty opaque path slot before the event path or e.gif. This is a template-completeness advisory, not a token encoding or vendor rejection contract.
params.fix_hint: Preserve the generated path slot from the original 00px callback template.

params.name: event_path
params.description: Tracking callbacks include a nonempty event path. The impression template ends in e.gif. No closed event vocabulary or event-to-VAST mapping is inferred.
params.fix_hint: Preserve the generated callback path without removing its final component.

params.name: s
params.description: Every reviewed callback from the published VAST example retains a nonempty opaque s query field, including error callbacks. Its meaning, encoding, authenticity and server rejection behavior are unverified.
params.fix_hint: Preserve the generated s field from the original callback. Do not invent or re-sign its value.
